summary: Build practical skills in organizational diagnosis, change planning, and adoption measurement. Explore the 5-day course and review the outline.
lede: Organizational development training helps HR partners, change leads, and operational managers diagnose organizational issues and plan workplace change. Learners use the Burke-Litwin model and force-field analysis to map evidence, barriers, and readiness, then apply Kotter’s 8-Step Process and ADKAR to plan communication and adoption. They also practise stakeholder impact mapping and tracking progress with adoption measures and Excel-based reports.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who diagnose organizational issues, coordinate workplace change, or advise leaders on adoption and implementation.
prerequisites: Prior experience working in an organizational, HR, operational, or change-related role is recommended. You should be familiar with workplace structures and team processes. No programming is required; exercises use organizational cases and spreadsheet-based planning.
